#250 · Rainbow Pokémon

Ho-Oh

Fire Flying

Johto · Generation 2 · Legendary Pokémon

Ho-Oh is a Fire/Flying-type Rainbow Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 3.8 m tall and weighs 199 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (154), with a base stat total of 680.
